主要内容: NORDIC AMERICAN TANKERS Ltd announced a public offering of $87 million in common shares, underwritten by Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC and other co-managers. The Company's Chairman, Herbjørn Hansson, is expected to purchase $1.5 million worth of shares. The underwriters have a 30-day option to buy an additional $13.05 million. Proceeds will be used for acquisitions and general corporate purposes. The company has 20 double-hull Suezmax tankers in its fleet and has entered into a preliminary agreement to acquire the Nordic Future, a modern double-hull Suezmax tanker, expected to be delivered by May 2013. The company is also reviewing potential vessel acquisitions for the near future.
